specification_semantics: unbounded LTL Safety; finite rollouts are sampled evidence, not a bounded replacement spec
zfree_definition: automaton priority is even and V_phi(z,q,r) < eta for every odd-priority head r
primary_event: P1/P2 hold over the rollout, Z_free is reached, and every subsequently observed product state through the finite horizon remains in Z_free
test_policy: freeze V_phi, eta, Z_free definition, event definition, and threshold before collecting the independent test split
interpretation_limit: sampled model-scope evidence over the observed horizon; not support-wide or infinite-time deductive closure
